Risk: Compromised PII (ID: credo-risk-036)
Description: The AI system may expose personally identifiable information (PII), either inadvertently or due to adversarial inputs, derived from training data, accessible data, or inferences. PII is any data that can be used to directly identify or contact a specific individual, either alone or in combination with other information.
Concern: None
Policy: Protected Health Information Handling

Axis: Direct Identifier Exposure (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PhotoAndLikenessExposure: Photo and Likeness Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NationalIDExposure: National ID Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#BiometricDataExposure: Biometric Data Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NameAndAddressExposure: Name and Address Exposure

Axis: Health Data Exposure (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure)
Roles: object
Subclasses:

  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DiagnosisExposure: Diagnosis Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrescriptionExposure: Prescription Exposure
